main_text.head: AD IOAN. IACOMOTVM BARRENSEM.
main_text.p:
Qvas strat& lacrymas diuino carmine fudit
Vates Hebræus patriæ,
Cur, age, sic renouans nobis, Iacomote, sonoræ
Tuæ maritas barbito?

Nempe istis similes quòd pœnas crimina nobis
Eadem minari prospicis.
Et quem non cura ista coquit, nisi qualis in orbe
Non vnus est Mezentius?

Ast vtinam sancti clamore excita Prophetæ,
Tuisque plectris obsequens,
Illa Sion nostro, quam condere tempore cœpit
Dei illa præpotens manus,

Tam propte lacrymis pauefacto expectore fusis
Restinguat iram numinis,
Quàm siccos retimens oculos vetus illa rebellis
Sese Sion pessum dedit.

page.notes: The first word "Quas" is a large woodcut-style initial Q; read as "Q" followed by "vas" written with a long-s form "strat&" as printed ("strat&" with long s). Line-initial italic lines are set in italic type throughout. The closing line "Theodorus Beza V." is set right of centre and is a signature, not a heading. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible in the background and is not transcribed.
